title: Multiplayer synchronization and validation
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: Two distinct players activate separate nearby relay pads during one round. The server owns gate state and replicates completion; a single player cannot trigger both pads or replay stale input.
expectedOutcomes: Distinct in-range players complete the gate and see the same replicated result.
Same-player, out-of-range, and stale requests are rejected.
failureCases: A pad request is duplicated or rate abused.
The second activation arrives after the pairing window.
